name: Chicken 65 Totopos
cooking_method: Marinate, coat just before frying, deep-fry in small batches at about 175 °C, probe to 74 °C; fry curry leaf and chile; fry the chips last

targets.fried totopos: about 60 g (from 55 g raw corn tortilla)

portion.construction: v1.0 = Construction C (composed board: chips, chicken and crema in controlled contact) because the T1 holding risk is chip softening; A (integrated) and B (ring) remain test constructions

lines.prep: boneless skinless thigh, trimmed, cut into 2.5-3 cm pieces
allocation: oil absorbed/degraded by frying the chicken
2 tortillas, dried 30 min, cut in 6-8 wedges
allocation: oil absorbed/degraded by frying the chips

steps: Day before: marinate chicken (yogurt, ginger-garlic, chilli, turmeric, coriander, salt, lemon) at 4 °C or below, 1 h to overnight (max 24 h). Make raita-crema and pickled onion.
Morning: dry corn tortillas 30 min, cut into wedges; weigh rice flour + cornflour 1:1; set fryer to 175 °C and check oil quality.

Service: toss marinated chicken in the flour mix just before frying; fry in small batches (about 4-5 min) until deep red-orange and crisp; probe every batch to 74 °C in the thickest piece; rest on a rack.
Fry curry leaf (15-20 s) and chile (about 30 s) and toss through the chicken; hold chicken on a rack at about 90 °C (T1 protocol).
Fry the chips LAST, immediately before plating (about 75-90 s at 170-175 °C until crisp), salt while hot.

critical_parameters.chip_crispness_gate: still crisp at T+10 min (T1 gate 3.5)

plating: Black stoneware plate or board. Chips fanned on one side, chicken pieces in a loose pile partly resting on a small rack/liner so steam escapes, a pool of raita-crema at the edge (not poured over), pickled onion in a small heap, fried curry leaves and green chile visible on top, lime wedge beside. Chicken pieces must look like boneless thigh pieces with a lightly crinkled, red-orange crust, not uniform nuggets.
equipment: Deep fryer (heavy load; two baskets: chicken and chips)
Cooling/draining rack and hot-hold at about 90 °C
food_safety: Poultry to 74 °C (165 °F), probed in the thickest piece on every fry batch.
Marinate at or below 4 °C; discard marinade; never reuse; separate raw-chicken board/utensils and hand-wash.
Hot-hold cooked chicken at or above 57 °C (135 °F); discard plates or held chicken over 2 hours (T1 rule).
Fryer: shared oil between chicken (milk in the marinade) and chips means NO allergen-free claim; filter and test oil quality on a schedule.
Hot oil safety, wet-food-in-oil splatter control, second person during peak (T1: execution risk medium).

morning: Dry and cut tortilla wedges (can be cut the day before, held dry)
Mix coating, verify fryer oil, mise en place garnishes
service: Dredge and fry chicken in batches; hot hold on rack
Fry curry leaf/chile with the last chicken batch
Fry chips to order, plate within 60 s
workflow.capacity_note: fryer is the bottleneck (shared with other fried items)

pairing.hypothesis: High carbonation and soft wheat body clean fry fat and soften chile heat; clove/banana esters may echo the spice. Existing matrix: BODY|CONTRAST|ECHO|HEAT.
pairing.risk: Banana ester against curry-leaf bitterness; thin body against a heavy fry.
pairing.status: PAIRING HYPOTHESIS - NOT SENSORY TESTED; the beer does not exist yet

pairing.hypothesis: Mango-tropical hop aroma echoes the lime and chile freshness.
pairing.risk: Hop bitterness (about 35 IBU objective) amplifies chile heat; juicy sweetness could stack with fried richness.
pairing.status: PAIRING HYPOTHESIS - NOT SENSORY TESTED; the beer does not exist yet

photography.hero: Overhead three-quarter angle, black stoneware plate, warm side light (low evening window light), shallow depth of field.
must_show: boneless thigh pieces with a crinkled red-orange crust, irregular sizes (2.5-3 cm)
visible fried curry leaves and slit green chile on the chicken
thick golden fried corn wedges (not thin factory chips)
a pool of white-pale raita-crema at the edge, pink pickled red onion heap, one lime wedge
must_not_show: cheese sauce or nacho-style toppings (GENERIC_NACHOS is a D-74 failure gate)
microgreens, sesame or ingredients not in the recipe
any text, logo or menu card
photography.realism_notes: Show a little oil sheen on the chips and a steam wisp only if the chicken is meant to be fresh; the chips must look sturdy enough to carry a piece of chicken.
